# URN conformance table, shared verbatim by go-mhda
# (testdata/urn_conformance.txt) and the C++ port (tests/data/urn_conformance.txt).
# Both test suites run every row through the lenient parser; an input one
# implementation refuses, the other refuses too, with the same error. Edit
# both copies together.
#
# Row forms:
#   accept urn <input URN> <canonical URN>
#   accept nss <input NSS> <canonical URN>
#   refuse urn <error> <input URN>
#   refuse nss <error> <input NSS>
# <error> is the C++ error_code name; go-mhda maps it to its sentinel
# (invalid_nss is ErrInvalidNSS, invalid_derivation_path is
# ErrInvalidDerivationPath, ...).

# A derivation path needs a derivation type other than root. Without dt the
# address is root, and a dp there would be dropped: the URN would name the
# root key instead of the path it spells out.
refuse urn invalid_derivation_path urn:mhda:nt:evm:ci:1:dp:m/44'/60'/0'/0/0
refuse urn invalid_derivation_path urn:mhda:nt:evm:ci:1:dt:root:dp:m/0
refuse urn invalid_derivation_path urn:mhda:nt:evm:ci:1:dt:ROOT:dp:m/0
refuse urn invalid_derivation_path urn:mhda:nt:ton:ci:mainnet:dt:root:dp:m/44'/607'/0'
refuse urn invalid_derivation_path urn:mhda:dp:m/44'/60'/0'/0/0:nt:evm:ci:1
refuse nss invalid_derivation_path nt:evm:ci:1:dp:m/44'/60'/0'/0/0
refuse urn invalid_derivation_path urn:mhda:nt:evm:ci:1:dt:bip44
accept urn urn:mhda:nt:ton:ci:mainnet urn:mhda:nt:ton:ci:mainnet
accept urn urn:mhda:nt:evm:ci:1:dt:bip44:dp:m/44'/60'/0'/0/0 urn:mhda:nt:evm:ci:1:dt:bip44:dp:m/44'/60'/0'/0/0
accept nss nt:evm:ci:1:dt:bip44:dp:m/44'/60'/0'/0/0 urn:mhda:nt:evm:ci:1:dt:bip44:dp:m/44'/60'/0'/0/0

# The NSS is a sequence of key:value pairs. An unknown key is skipped
# together with its value (forward compatibility), so a following known key
# is never read as its value. A key that differs from a known key only by
# case is refused rather than skipped, and so is a token without a value.
refuse urn invalid_nss urn:mhda:nt:evm:ci:1:DT:bip44:DP:m/44'/60'/0'/0/5
refuse urn invalid_nss urn:mhda:nt:evm:ci:1:dt:bip44:dp:m/44'/60'/0'/0/0:WI:wallet-A
refuse urn invalid_nss urn:mhda:NT:evm:ci:1
refuse urn invalid_nss urn:mhda:nt:evm:Ci:1
accept urn urn:mhda:nt:evm:ci:1:ext:wi:dt:bip44:dp:m/44'/60'/0'/0/5 urn:mhda:nt:evm:ci:1:dt:bip44:dp:m/44'/60'/0'/0/5
accept urn urn:mhda:nt:evm:ci:1:xx:future urn:mhda:nt:evm:ci:1
accept urn urn:mhda:xx:nt:nt:evm:ci:1 urn:mhda:nt:evm:ci:1
refuse urn invalid_nss urn:mhda:nt:evm:ci:1:garbage
refuse urn invalid_nss urn:mhda:nt:evm:junk:ci:1
refuse urn invalid_nss urn:mhda:nt:evm:ci:1:
refuse urn invalid_nss urn:mhda::nt:evm:ci:1
refuse urn invalid_nss urn:mhda:nt:evm:ci:1::x
refuse urn invalid_nss urn:mhda:nt:evm:ci:1:xx:
refuse urn missing_network_type urn:mhda:
refuse nss invalid_nss nt:evm:ci:1:foo
accept nss nt:evm:ci:1:wt:web3 urn:mhda:nt:evm:ci:1:wt:web3
